title: Answer: the micro fixes everything but need not do the causal work

statements.text: The micro mechanisms fix every macro level, with no extra causal ingredients added above them. What is fundamental in that sense is the micro, but causal power is not confined to it.

sources.locator: Discussion, Micro Macro Mappings and Repertoires of Alternatives
sources.quote: no extra causal ingredients are added at the macro level, such as rules that apply to the macro only
